- **Binary Size (v0.0.2)**: 8.4 MB Universal Binary DMG (8,798,017 bytes • Released November 10, 2026)
- **Previous Release (v0.0.1 Build 1)**: https://github.com/Shubham-sharma8/helium/releases/download/v0.0.1/Helium.dmg (5.3 MB • `45e6fc4e7c1af050843f8d1a8ca860a46fb8f2d7688edacf357adbf12f0fedea` • Released November 7, 2026)
- **System Requirements**: macOS 15.4+ / macOS 26 Tahoe (Apple Silicon & Intel)
- **Mount Point**: `/Volumes/Helium` (APFS Sparse Placeholders • `0 B on disk` • HTTP Range 206 Streaming)
- **Capabilities**: Multi-Protocol & Multi-Provider Cloud Support (25+ presets: Google Drive Pool via OAuth 2.0 PKCE with 64 MiB RAID-0 cross-account striping; S3-compatible Amazon S3, Cloudflare R2, Backblaze B2, Wasabi, Hetzner, DigitalOcean Spaces, Storj DCS, Tigris, GCS HMAC, MinIO/Garage/Ceph; WebDAV Nextcloud, ownCloud, Fastmail Files, pCloud, Synology NAS; SFTP/SSH Hetzner Storage Box, rsync.net, standard SFTP; SMB/Bonjour NAS & Azure Files; BYOK OAuth Dropbox, OneDrive, Box; External USB/Thunderbolt SSD; Smart Endpoint & Region Inference); 5-Step Safe-Write Verification (ms latency, TLS 1.3/1.2 cert chain, read/list permissions, SHA-256 canary write/read check, 0 B residue cleanup); Scheduled Add-Only Mac Folder Backups (`⌘⇧K`) with 1-click presets, exclusion preview, add-only `/Volumes/Helium/Backups` safety, countdown ring & 14-run history dots; Time Travel Snapshots & "Then vs. Now" Diffing (`⌘⇧Y`) with Restore Copy & Restore Version; Right-Hand File Inspector & Non-Destructive Conflict Resolution (Keep Both / Use Newer); Activity & Health (`⌘⇧A`) with self-healing cards & live dual-series throughput chart; Executable Command Palette (`⌃⌥O`); Privacy Network Contact Map (0 analytics/telemetry) & Save Redacted Log.
